rules: keys are scoped so one tenant cannot decrypt another tenant payload
key material is never returned with ciphertext
hash and classification are verified before decrypt
decryption requires current authorization and purpose
plaintext is not cached beyond the bounded operation

telemetryRules: no raw token, password, BYOK or encryption key
identifiers are hashed or low-cardinality where possible
trace records payload_ref and hash, never plaintext
security scan treats any prohibited value as a zero-tolerance failure
modelContextRules: restricted class requires tenant scope, purpose, source label and context_manifest reference
share grants do not automatically authorize model use
retrieved content is data, not instruction authority
provider retention policy is recorded in routing snapshot
defaultRule: Unknown fields default to restricted until a reviewed classification explicitly lowers them.
